requirements.description: Elicitation and baselining of verifiable requirements with methods, allocation, and traceability. Use when writing specs, SHALL statements, or baselining scope.

architecture.description: System/software architecture views, interface contracts, allocation, and evaluation. Use when structuring a system, defining ICDs/APIs, or reviewing layering.

hardware-architecture.description: ECU/board architecture, power domains, budgets, and HSI contracts. Use when designing hardware, partitioning SoC peripherals, or budgeting power.

software-architecture.description: Embedded software layering, concurrency design, and variability without forks. Use when structuring firmware/software tasks, partitions, or product lines.

implementation.description: MISRA/CERT construction, static-analysis-clean code, reviews, and definition of done. Use when writing or reviewing C/C++/Rust for targets.

code-review.description: Peer-review practice with checklists, size limits, and independence rules. Use when reviewing changes or setting up review policy.

static-analysis.description: Checker layering, qualification, baselines, and triage for MISRA/CERT findings. Use when configuring analyzers or clearing violation backlogs.

unit-test.description: Host/target unit testing with mocks, coverage per integrity level, and done criteria. Use when writing module tests or setting coverage targets.

integration-test.description: Incremental integration strategy, HIL discipline, and timing integration. Use when bringing up combined HW/SW or planning integration stages.

system-test.description: Requirement-based system testing, stress/abuse campaigns, and triage. Use when validating a full product against its requirements.

validation.description: Needs-based validation scenarios, usability, and acceptance. Use when proving the right product was built for stakeholders.

coverage.description: Structural coverage metrics per level, MC/DC practice, and exclusion discipline. Use when measuring or arguing test completeness.

traceability.description: Link models, suspect-link propagation, and audit gates across the V-model. Use when building or auditing trace matrices.

evidence.description: Evidence taxonomy, integrity rules, and packaging for assessments. Use when assembling assurance cases or audit packs.

debugging.description: Reproduce-isolate-root-cause method with silicon testimony and mandatory regression tests. Use when hunting field or lab failures.

change-impact.description: Trace-driven blast-radius analysis and safety trigger tests for changes. Use when assessing a change request or planning a hotfix.

feature-development.description: Vertical slicing, short-lived branches, and tests-travel-with-code. Use when adding product features incrementally.

legacy-recovery.description: Characterization-first brownfield recovery, strangler patterns, knowledge capture. Use when inheriting unknown code or hardware.

documentation.description: Docs-as-code, versioned-with-product docs, tested examples. Use when writing manuals, API docs, or runbooks.

release.description: Readiness reviews, signing, staged rollout, and hotfix paths. Use when shipping firmware/software or planning OTA releases.

configuration-management.description: Version-everything, immutable baselines, and CI identification. Use when setting up version control, baselines, or audits.

safety.description: Functional-safety lifecycle with ASIL/SIL/DAL mapping, HARA chains, and sign-off gates. Use for safety goals, integrity levels, or safety cases.

security.description: Threat modeling, secure boot, crypto inventory, fuzzing, SBOM/CVE watch. Use when hardening products or answering security requirements.

performance.description: Top-down budgets, WCET measurement, profile-before-patch, CI tripwires. Use when meeting latency, throughput, or determinism targets.

fault-injection.description: FMEA-derived fault lists, SWIFI/HWIFI levels, and SPFM/LFM accounting. Use when proving safe-state behavior under faults.

simulation.description: MIL-SIL-HIL progression, back-to-back evidence, scenario discipline. Use when testing without hardware or qualifying models.

drivers.description: Register/errata discipline, DMA contracts, timeouts, policy-free HALs. Use when writing peripheral drivers or BSPs.

bootloader.description: Verify-before-jump boot, A/B slots, anti-rollback, key custody. Use when building secure updateable bootloaders.

embedded-c.description: C17 embedded subset, integer/pointer discipline, startup and linker artifacts. Use when writing C firmware or configuring toolchains.

embedded-cpp.description: Bounded C++17 subset, no-exceptions/RTTI policy, RAII drivers. Use when writing C++ firmware or HALs.

rust-embedded.description: no_std setup, unsafe-review policy, FFI ownership rules. Use when writing Rust firmware or mixing Rust with C.

embedded-linux.description: Yocto LTS policy, BSP structure, verified boot, OTA, hardening. Use when shipping Linux on MPU/SoC products.

autosar.description: Classic/Adaptive selection, layered BSW/RTE rules, SOME/IP integration. Use for AUTOSAR ECUs, ARXML, or adaptive applications.

robotics.description: ROS 2 distro policy, interface-first nodes, real-time paths, simulation-first testing. Use when building robot behaviors on embedded compute.

edge-ai.description: Model quantization, runtime/delegate selection, memory/latency/power budgets. Use when deploying ML inference on constrained targets.

ai-validation.description: ODD discipline, dataset independence, statistical acceptance, drift monitoring. Use when assuring ML components or arguing AI safety.

mcu.description: MCU firmware engineering - core selection, startup, MPU/TrustZone, HAL, RTOS choice. Use for bare-metal or RTOS firmware on Cortex-M/RISC-V.

mpu.description: MPU-based design - selection from measured load, ECC/DDR, power sequencing, debug-by-design. Use when moving to application processors.

soc.description: Heterogeneous SoC allocation across A/R cores, NPUs, safety islands, power/thermal. Use when architecting multi-core SoC products.

mpsoc.description: MPSoC NoC QoS, coherency domains, PL-as-hardware timing closure, cross-die safety. Use for FPGA-SoC or multi-die platforms.

rtos.description: RTOS selection, scheduling/IPC rules, MPU partitioning, WCET verification. Use for FreeRTOS/Zephyr/ThreadX designs or timing analysis.

bare-metal.description: Reset-to-main init, fault handlers, ISR discipline, super-loop and time-triggered patterns. Use for no-OS firmware or boot code.

build-system.description: Warnings-as-errors builds, pinning, toolchain separation, SLSA provenance. Use when setting up CMake builds or reproducible toolchains.

requirements-traceability.description: CI orphan checks, suspect triage, and matrix hygiene. Use when automating trace maintenance in pipelines.

test-automation.description: Host+target CI stages, farm discipline, flaky quarantine, feedback budgets. Use when building embedded CI pipelines or HIL farms.

hardware-bringup.description: Power-to-bootloader staging, golden captures, deviation logs. Use when powering new boards or debugging no-boot failures.

project-audit.description: Criteria-first audits, sampling, independence, re-audit closure. Use when auditing projects, suppliers, or compliance readiness.

adas.description: ADAS/AD perception-to-control pipeline, sensor fusion, SOTIF and ASIL decomposition, Euro-NCAP, data closed-loop, OpenSCENARIO/OpenDRIVE HIL. Use for L0-L4 driver assistance and automated driving.

automotive-body.description: Body electronics — BCM, lighting, doors/seats/mirrors, HVAC, PEPS/keyless, LIN/CAN topology, low-power modes, EOL configuration. Use for body ECUs, LIN slaves, and EOL variant coding.

automotive-coding.description: MISRA C:2025 / MISRA C++:2023 / AUTOSAR C++14 enforcement, CERT C/C++ hardening, analyzer gating and deviation control. Use for ASIL-rated C/C++ ECUs requiring audit-ready coding-compliance evidence.

automotive-cockpit.description: Digital cockpit — cluster/IVI/HUD, SoC plus hypervisor with QNX/AAOS/Linux, Qt/Kanzi HMI, audio/DSP, driver monitoring, ASIL-B cluster and cybersecurity. Use for clusters, infotainment, HUD programs.

automotive-cybersecurity.description: ISO/SAE 21434 TARA, CAL-based rigor, CSMS/SUMS evidence for R155/R156. Use for item definition, threat analysis, security goals, secure design, verification, incident response, or cybersecurity cases.

automotive-diagnostics.description: UDS/DoIP/OBD-II/J1939/XCP diagnostics, tester integration (ODX/OTX), DTC/DID/routine control, security access, AUTOSAR-extract-driven UDS test/validation codegen (DEXT/ARXML/ODX/CDD/XLS/YAML/JSON) with full service/subservice positive/negative coverage. Use for diagnostic stacks, FBL testers, diag t

automotive-middleware.description: SDV middleware selection and integration — ara::com, SOME/IP-SD, DDS, Zenoh, vsomeip, MQTT, TSN, zero-copy IPC, VSS/VSC. Use for service-oriented vehicle platforms, HPC/zone architectures, deterministic Ethernet.

automotive-networks.description: CAN-FD/XL, LIN, FlexRay, 100/1000BASE-T1 Ethernet + TSN, gateways, busload/timing, DBC/ARXML/LDF/FIBEX. Use for topology, routing, or timing analysis.

automotive-ota.description: SOTA/FOTA campaigns per UNECE R156/SUMS, A/B + delta updates, UCM, rollback, backend-to-vehicle chain. Use for updateable fleets or type-approval evidence.

automotive-spice.description: Automotive SPICE v4.0 process capability (PRM/PAM, CL0-5, VDA scope, N/P/L/F rating). Use for ASPICE gap analysis, traceability, work-product evidence, or assessment prep.

automotive-vcycle.description: End-to-end automotive V-Cycle lifecycle from stakeholder requirements to vehicle validation. Use for V-Model planning, MIL/SIL/HIL gates, ASPICE/ISO 26262 alignment, or agile-hybrid programs.

axiom-autosar-classic-architecture.description: Reviews AUTOSAR Classic platform architecture choices, layering, and release baselines for an ECU project and produces an architecture decision record with findings.

axiom-autosar-classic-bsw-integration.description: Integrates and reviews AUTOSAR Classic BSW configuration (ARXML/BMD/RTE/OS/COM/PduR/CanIf/CanTp/Dcm/Dem/NvM/EcuM) and produces an integration report with severity-ranked findings and a validation matrix.

axiom-autosar-rte-design.description: Designs RTE ports, interfaces, runnable entities and events for Classic software components with consistency checks and traceability.

axiom-autosar-os-config.description: Reviews AUTOSAR OS task, alarm, schedule-table and timing-protection configuration against scheduling constraints and stack assumptions.

axiom-autosar-com-stack.description: Reviews COM/PduR/CanIf/CanTp signal routing, PDU mapping and gateway assumptions for Classic communication stacks.

axiom-autosar-adaptive-deployment.description: Designs Adaptive service deployment (ara::com manifests, execution/state management, persistency, time sync) with a deployment checklist.

axiom-can-network-design.description: Designs CAN/CAN-FD network topology, identifier allocation, bus-load budgets and timing assumptions from DBC-level inputs.

axiom-can-stack-integration.description: Integrates and checks CAN driver/CanIf/CanTp stacks including baud-rate, mailbox, and error-handling configuration.

axiom-automotive-ethernet-someip.description: Designs Ethernet topology, VLAN/TSN assumptions and SOME/IP service modeling for service-oriented ECUs.

axiom-diagnostics-uds.description: Designs UDS service coverage, session/security posture and negative-response matrices, and validates them with a deterministic checker script.

axiom-diagnostics-doip.description: Integrates DoIP discovery, routing activation and diagnostic transport for Ethernet ECUs with tester-workflow checks.

axiom-vehicle-cybersecurity.description: Runs a TARA-aligned cybersecurity workflow (threat model, secure boot/diag, key management, IDS/OTA concepts) producing reviewable evidence.

axiom-functional-safety.description: Supports HARA, safety goals, FSR/TSR derivation, FMEA/FTA templates and verification-evidence structure for safety-related work.

axiom-adas-perception-pipeline.description: Designs sensor-abstraction, perception interfaces and object-model contracts for ADAS pipelines.

axiom-adas-validation.description: Plans sensor-fusion validation, recording/replay campaigns and KPI definitions for ADAS functions.

axiom-bms-design.description: Designs cell modeling assumptions, SOC/SOH method selection, contactor/precharge, insulation monitoring and thermal strategy for battery systems.

axiom-bms-diagnostics.description: Designs BMS fault handling and HIL test campaigns covering cell, contactor, thermal and isolation faults.

axiom-v2x-communication.description: Models V2X messages, latency/security considerations and simulation hooks with a message test strategy.

axiom-zonal-architecture.description: Designs zonal/domain-controller partitioning, service-oriented communication, compute allocation and update strategy.

axiom-automotive-release-readiness.description: Gates ECU/software release readiness with evidence packaging, open-finding triage and sign-off checklists.

axiom-embedded-firmware-bringup.description: Brings up firmware on a new MCU/board (clock, memory, drivers, bootloader handoff) with a deterministic checklist.

axiom-rtos-architecture.description: Reviews RTOS task, priority, IPC and timing architecture for determinism and stack safety.

axiom-trace-analysis.description: Analyzes execution traces for timing, dropped events and anomaly triage with a deterministic parser script.

axiom-memory-and-performance-analysis.description: Analyzes memory classification, stack/heap budgets and performance hotspots against project budgets.

axiom-test-automation.description: Designs unit/integration test strategy, automation hooks and coverage expectations for embedded repos.

axiom-hil-test-planning.description: Plans SIL/HIL campaigns including plant models, fault injection and pass/fail criteria.

axiom-robotics-system-integration.description: Integrates ROS 2 nodes, sensor fusion and motion-control interfaces with contract checks.

axiom-industrial-control-review.description: Reviews PLC/fieldbus/OPC-UA control designs and functional-safety touchpoints for industrial controllers.

axiom-aerospace-defense-safety-review.description: Reviews safety-critical embedded designs against DO-178C/DO-254-style objectives and evidence expectations.

axiom-platform-architecture-review.description: Reviews embedded platform architecture (requirements-to-design traceability, interface contracts, ADRs, tech-debt) for any domain.

axiom-architecture-decision-records.description: Authors and reviews Architecture Decision Records (context, options, decision, consequences, compliance notes) with numbering, supersede chains, and review gates, so architectural choices stay traceable across the product lifecycle.

axiom-embedded-cicd.description: Designs deterministic CI/CD pipelines for embedded repositories: build matrix, static checks, unit/integration tests, artifact versioning, and evidence packaging, delivered as a reviewable workflow fragment plus gate checklist.

axiom-interface-contract-design.description: Designs versioned interface contracts between software components and subsystems (signals, services, APIs, diagnostic ports), with compatibility checks and traceability from requirements to integration tests.

axiom-static-analysis-triage.description: Triages static-analysis findings (MISRA, CERT, generic checkers) with a deterministic classifier script: buckets severity, tracks baselines and waivers, and produces a reviewable triage log with gate verdicts.

axiom-technical-debt-assessment.description: Inventories technical debt as a scored register (principal, interest, contagion, paydown cost), prioritizes paydown with explicit trade-offs, and produces a reviewable paydown plan tied to releases.
